sections.p: The pad is a blue square memo with a window, holding 4 designs of 20 sheets each, 80 sheets in total. Through the window you see the design of the sheet in use, and it changes each time you use one. It is marked as made in Japan.

A good fit for Opanchu Usagi fans who like cute stationery. Use it for quick notes, or for letters and messages as the seller suggests. With 4 designs, you can pick the one that suits what you are writing.
